Enum SqlFilterExpressionType

Namespace
Tripous.Data

Indicates the type of a filter expression.

See the SqlFilterExpressions.txt file for the filter syntax.

Fields

Date = 1

A date filter.

[[date:Label]] or [[date:custom:Label]] is a Custom date. The user must enter the date in the runtime UI.

[[date:LastMonth:Label]] is a computed date. The system computes the date in the runtime UI.

The DateRange enumeration type contains the valid literals for this setting.

Decimal = 3

A decimal filter

The user must enter the value in the runtime UI.

[[dec:Label]]

Enum = 5

A list of constants. The user provides a list of possible values in the design-time UI. The user selects one or more constants in the runtime UI.

[[enum:string:date|int|dec:Label]] - single choise

[[enum:multi:string:date|int|dec:Label]] - multi choise

Integer = 2

A integer filter

The user must enter the value in the runtime UI.

[[int:Label]]

Lookup = 4

A filter with a lookup SELECT Sql. The user must define the LookUp Sql in the design-time UI.

The lookup SELECT is executed by the runtime UI and it returns one or more rows.

The first column of the returned result list, is the Result Column, and it is used as the value in the runtime UI.

The user must choose one or more rows in the runtime UI.

[[lookup:Label]] - single choise

[[lookup:multi:Label]] - multi choise

String = 0

A string filter.

The user must enter the value in the runtime UI.

[[Label]] or [[string:Label]]
